Notes: THE HIDDEN ROLL. Somebody has to have given the ball away, and this is where it is decided - out of sight, so the moment reads as football rather than as a dice throw. `out_of_bounds_player_chance` in Tuning.csv weights it. Seconds 0 because nothing is shown.
HE PUTS IT OUT. The guilty player strikes the ball to the nearest touchline and it crosses the line. Seconds is how long the ball takes to get there.
The referee. Seconds 0 - a sound starts and the list carries on over the top of it.

THE ANIMATION WINDOW. Text is the caption; Animation is a row of Animations.csv played on THAT PLAYER'S OWN spritesheet, so it works today with art you already have. Put a file name in Art instead to show a picture you drew. This is the template the round notes promise: it runs before any new art exists.

THE RESTART IS WALKED TO. The nearest player of the side restarting goes to where it is taken from - outside the touchline for a throw-in, the corner flag for a corner, the six-yard box for a goal kick (round AC, see PlayMakerStarts.csv). A keeper's ball and a drop ball have no walk. Seconds is how long the walk takes.
The big word across the middle of the pitch, for Seconds and then it clears. {call} is the Call column of PlayMakerStarts.csv (THROW-IN, CORNER, ...).
